attributes.action: General Election in the event that Kier Starmer resigns as Prime Minister
attributes.additional_details:
I am calling for the King to dissolve parliament and trigger a general election if Kier Starmer resigns.

The labour government came into power under the guise of working for the people and on a manifest of blatant LIES, every single "Promise" they made to the electorate they did the total opposite, this country has had too much and we cannot take anymore.

It's time for the people to elect a government that will work for us and does what they say they will
attributes.background: I am calling for the King to dissolve parliament and trigger a general election if Kier Starmer resigns

rejection.details:
We can't publish petitions that request actions by the King, as these are decisions for the crown, and not the Government or House of Commons.

If you're concerned about a particular policy or decision that's the responsibility of Government or the House of Commons, you could sign or start a petition about that.

You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
